verdict.rationale: Inngest documents step memoization and automatic retries which give exactly-once execution for each step (docs-2, docs-15) and durable-agent checkpointing (docs-21), but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of an idempotency-key mechanism for deduplicating incoming event triggers (e.g., to stop a duplicate webhook from double-charging), which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit idempotency-key/event-deduplication docs, and independent/community verification that duplicate triggers are actually suppressed in practice.
